_doc: The end-of-episode page of Enma's Ledger (docs/GDD.md 4.14, LORE 9, src/ui/ledger_page.gd). Ledger.entries() picks the entries that apply (in this order) and fills {who} {n} {name} {title}. domyo = the right shoulder (white, polite, counts good deeds), dosho = the left shoulder (black, teasing, counts bad ones); they argue every entry, then stamp it: good | bad | argued (both brushes at once).
title: ENMA'S LEDGER
subtitle: Episode 0 - written by Domyo (right shoulder) and Dosho (left shoulder)

intro.domyo: Good evening, Asagiri-sama. We have been sitting on your shoulders since spring. If you would permit us, we will read you the page.
intro.dosho: Sit down, it's a long one. You did a LOT of stuff. Some of it was even good.

mirror_intro: Enma's mirror of pure crystal shows every deed exactly as it happened. It never lies, and it never looks away.
mirror_dosho: Ooh, the mirror. My favourite part. You can't argue with the mirror. (I always try.)
mirror_domyo: Please look carefully, Asagiri-sama. This is what we saw from your shoulders.
mirror_empty: The mirror is full of rain. Somewhere behind it, a boy in a hood is looking back at you.

outro.domyo: The page is closed. Whatever is written here, the next life will read.
outro.dosho: And whatever ISN'T written here, I'll remember anyway. Bye-bye, Asagiri.

route_romance.text: Nekomori Amane, 1-A: you chose him. Confessions, festival dates, a hand held at the bridge.
domyo: Love is the oldest good deed there is. He waited a hundred and fifty years. You came.
dosho: You dated a boy whose jealousy walks around at night with two tails. Bold. Stupid. Bold.

route_friend.text: Nekomori Amane, 1-A: you stayed his friend - not more, never less.
domyo: A friend who stays is rarer than a lover who comes and goes. This is a good deed, clearly.
dosho: He wanted more. You knew. You kept him close anyway. Hm. ...Fine. It counts. Barely.

route_boundary.text: Nekomori Amane, 1-A: you said no, kindly, clearly, again and again.
domyo: To refuse someone without making them small - very few people manage that. We bow.
dosho: He cried a river. Literally, the river flooded. But okay, okay. No is a complete sentence.

route_ignore.text: Nekomori Amane, 1-A: you looked through him, as if he were the transparent one.
domyo: Perhaps you were protecting yourself. I will write that down, too. In small letters.
dosho: He was right there, crying in the rain, every single day. You wanted to be invisible? Congratulations, you made HIM invisible.

route_none.text: Nekomori Amane, 1-A: you never decided what he was to you.
domyo: Not deciding can be gentleness. Sometimes.
dosho: Not deciding is deciding, Asagiri. Ask the rain.

fate_injured.text: {who} was hurt. A cat with two tails was standing in the road when it happened.
fate_injured.mirror: {who}, at the bottom of the hill
domyo: You did not push anyone. But you knew the cat's name. I am very sorry.
dosho: Not your paw, not your crime? Cute theory. The ledger has a column for 'let it happen'.

fate_hidden.text: {who} was hidden away (kamikakushi). Nobody in Suzunari remembers his face clearly any more.
domyo: We will keep his name here, so at least the ledger remembers him.
dosho: Spirited away. Gone. Poof. And you got a very attached boyfriend-ish person out of it. Worth it? I'm asking for Enma.

fate_cut.text: The red thread between you and {who} was bitten through.
domyo: Threads can be tied again. I am writing this one in pencil.
dosho: He'll walk past you in the corridor like a stranger. Nice and quiet. Just how you wanted to live, right?

cat_plan.text: {n} night(s) as the black cat, you went on with the plan.
domyo: You felt what he feels. That is not nothing. But you did it.
dosho: You had paws, you had a choice, and you chose MAYHEM. My favourite student.

cat_resist.text: {n} night(s) as the black cat, you turned around and went home.
domyo: Every step back to the shrine hurt him, and you took it anyway. That is courage, written small.
dosho: He woke up sobbing. Good deed, sure. Tell that to his pillow.

cat_window.text: {n} night(s) as the black cat, you sat at your own window and watched yourself sleep.
domyo: Nobody was hurt. He only wanted to be near. I count it as tender.
dosho: Watching someone sleep from their windowsill. All night. Domyo, that's a CRIME in most prefectures.

cat_skip.text: {n} night(s) you stayed asleep and let the cat go on without you.
domyo: To refuse to be the jealousy... perhaps that is a kind of answer.
dosho: Asleep while it happened. Classic. 'Wasn't me, I was in bed.'

eavesdrop.text: You listened at {n} window(s) in the night and learned what you shouldn't know.
domyo: You will use it to help them. I'm sure. I'm... fairly sure.
dosho: Nosy little cat. I approve. Enma doesn't.

knock.text: You knocked {n} thing(s) off the town's shelves, steps and sills.
domyo: It was a cat thing to do. Cats are forgiven a great deal.
dosho: The jizo's rice cracker. You ate the JIZO'S RICE CRACKER. I'm putting a star next to this one.

seen.text: As the black cat, you were seen {n} time(s) by the night watch.
domyo: Being seen is not a sin. Being a two-tailed cat in front of a policeman is merely careless.
dosho: The torch! The drunk! The STONE DOGS! You were a disaster of a cat. I loved every second.

cheat.text: You copied answers in an exam {n} time(s) and nobody saw.
domyo: Somebody saw. We are on your shoulders, Asagiri-sama.
dosho: Nobody saw! Except us. And we're telling EVERYONE. Well. Enma.

cheat_caught.text: You were caught copying in an exam {n} time(s).
domyo: You took the zero without arguing. I am writing that down too, on the good side, in very small letters.
dosho: Caught! By MAKABE! The man who notices everything! What did you expect?

domyo: A number is not a person. Still, please sleep more before the next one.
dosho: Middle of the pack. Or lower. Invisible, just how you like it. Proud of you. Sort of.

domyo: Diligence, rewarded. Your grandfather would have pinned it to the shop wall.
dosho: Nerd. ...Fine. It's a good deed. Don't let it go to your head.

domyo: A promise is a debt to the words themselves. Kotodama will wait. Patiently.
dosho: Kotodama will wait. Kotodama will also COLLECT. Next episode. With interest.

domyo: Maybe something came up. I'll write 'something came up'.
dosho: 'Same time tomorrow?' 'Sure!' ...And then you just didn't. I wrote it in red. Twice.

pickups.text: You walked to school with friends {n} time(s). Most often with {who}.
domyo: Fifteen minutes of walking together. Small, and it adds up to a whole life.
dosho: You want to be invisible but you keep ringing people's doorbells at 7:50. Make up your mind.

domyo: Some days, the classroom is too loud. Makabe-sensei noticed, though. He always notices.
dosho: Skipped. And skipped. And skipped. The rice crackers on the roof were nice, though?

domyo: You turned up. For someone who wishes to be nobody, turning up is a great deal.
dosho: Joined a club. Next you'll be making friends on PURPOSE. Disgusting.

domyo: Honest work, honestly paid. A clean entry.
dosho: Money! What will you buy? A train ticket? An umbrella for a crybaby? I know which one.

eggs.text: {n} of the town's secrets found (the hidden ones).
domyo: Curiosity is how the town knows it is loved.
dosho: You poked every shrine, pillow and jizo in Suzunari. Something poked back. Just saying.

zukan.text: {n} pages of the Hyakki Zukan filled - yokai met and not run from.
domyo: You were polite to the rokurokubi. She will remember that for three hundred years.
dosho: You befriended a kappa. A KAPPA. Your grandpa would be so proud and so confused.

domyo: Whatever came of it, you wanted something. When you arrived, you wanted nothing at all.
dosho: Big dreams, little effort. Typical second-year.

domyo: I would like to write this one as good. Dosho will not let me.
dosho: And I'd like to write it as bad, and Domyo won't let ME. So we write it together. Annoying.
